text:
maya: seeing a spike of reconnects from a handful of tenants, looks like bursty reconnects are getting rate-limited and then clients start hammering again

zach: yep noticed metric 'sse.reconnects.count' jumps then 'sse.ratelimit.penalty_applied' follows immediately

sam: is that the new reconnect penalty token bucket? i thought it should only penalize sustained churn, not short bursts on resume

maya: agreed. reproducer: open connection, send a couple events, then force a resume loop by killing backend -> client reconnects 3x in 10s -> we apply penalty and blackhole for 30s, client retries every 2s -> double-churn

zach: logs from last incident: ``
[ingress] client=tenant-42 conn=abc123 reconnects=4
[quota] apply_penalty tenant=tenant-42 reason=reconnect_burst window=30s
[router] sticky_route=false -> fallback=stateless
``

maya: problem 1: penalty window is global per-tenant and doesn't decay per-route. so if a tenant has many short-lived sessions across routes it gets hit hard.

sam: problem 2: console metrics show reconnects aggregated but console dashboard uses per-route latency instead of per-tenant reconnect rate. so SRE sees healthy latency but customers call complaining about disconnect loops.

console-team: this is because our dashboard pipeline currently maps metrics by route_id first, then tenant. we can flip the join but will need a re-index of the timeseries (low priority job).

zach: short-term mitigation: reduce penalty duration from 30s -> 6s for reconnects <= 5 within 20s, and add jittered backoff advice to the client lib. longer term: move penalty to route-scoped buckets + expose reconnect_window metric to customers.

maya: also need to handle sticky routing. We flip to fallback stateless on penalty which loses KV-cache affinity, causing cold starts and more latency -> more disconnects. maybe don't downgrade routing on penalty.

sam: can we change fallback policy: on reconnect penalty keep same route affinity if session_id present, but limit QPS? that maintains KV cache while still throttling.

zach: agree. change plan: (1) short-term config tweak in router: keep sticky=true for penalized sessions with session_id, and cap inflight=1. (2) metric fix: add tenant-first aggregation pipeline for reconnects and expose alert. (3) client lib: exponential backoff w/ capped attempts and log suggestion to contact support if >10 attempts.

infra-bot: deploy-plan created: PR #4123 targets router config and metrics pipeline. canary group = beta tenants (10). ETA deploy to canary: 1987654360

maya: canary results?

zach: canary showed reconnects drop 70% on affected tenants, penalty events down to almost none. console still mis-attributing some events during reindex window though.

console-team: reindex scheduled off-hours. will add a temporary overlay in the console that shows tenant-aggregated reconnects until index finishes.

sam: sounds good. can we also add a tiny note in the rollout UI docs: "Reconnect penalty now route-aware; expect fewer tenant-wide blackholes" so support isn't surprised.

maya: thanks. follow-ups: update client lib snippet, roll router config to prod after reindex, add alert "tenant reconnect burst" with page severity P2.

zach: I'll open the follow-up issues.
